# vita-memio 1.3.0

This release adds **Read ahead**, a per-game **overlay** and a **test that picks settings for your game**. Your storage still starts switched off, and *Read ahead* stays off until you turn it on.

## New

**Read ahead** (*Settings > Devices > vita-memio > Advanced*). While a file is read in order, the console's spare core reads the next part early, so the card does not sit idle between requests. On my console, with a microSD in an SD2Vita:

| Test | Unit | Read ahead off | Read ahead on |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Sequential read 1 MiB | MiB/s | 18.7 | **21.8** |
| Sequential read 128 KiB | MiB/s | 16.6 | **27.9** |
| Random read 4 KiB | IOPS | 370.4 | 371 |
| Random read 32 KiB | IOPS | 359.9 | 360.2 |
| Random read 128 KiB | IOPS | 132.9 | 132.8 |
| Random read 1 MiB | IOPS | 18.8 | 18.4 |
| Graphics data (NC) read 1 MiB | MiB/s | 20.6 | **24.2** |
| Graphics data (NC) read 128 KiB | MiB/s | 19.2 | **40.1** |
| NCphy read 1 MiB | MiB/s | 20.7 | **24.3** |
| CDRAM read 1 MiB | MiB/s | 20.6 | **25** |
| Files read | files/s | 187 | **237.5** |
| Files created | files/s | 110.4 | 114.3 |
| Files deleted | files/s | 216.9 | 217.1 |
| Sequential write 1 MiB | MiB/s | 14.2 | 15.6 |
| Random write 4 KiB | IOPS | 180.4 | 180.6 |
| Random write 32 KiB | IOPS | 292.3 | 374.8 |
| Random write 128 KiB | IOPS | 116.5 | 119.2 |
| Random write 1 MiB | IOPS | 16.2 | 15.6 |

**These gains are from the benchmark, which reads files strictly in order. In real use the gain is smaller**, and in games it depends on how each game reads: some gain a lot, some almost nothing.

Read ahead does not touch random reads or writes, so differences in those rows are just normal variation between runs. Measured with the tester (quick profile: 16 MiB file, 3 runs), microSD in an SD2Vita, PCH-1000 on firmware 3.65, GPU-safe reads and Overlapped reads *Auto* on.

It is never used on the internal storage, and anything written over the data read early makes it unusable, so it can never be stale.

**Overlay** (*SELECT + Right* in any game, once switched on in *Advanced*). Read ahead, copying, overlapped reads and GPU-safe reads for the game in front, each with its own saved profile.

**R/A test.** In the overlay, *Start R/A Test*, play for a few minutes including a loading screen, then *Stop R/A Test*. It works out what read ahead brings this game and saves the result for it. It judges from how the game reads and cannot see the frame rate.

## Changed

- **Copy on the system core** is now Off, Cached only, **C + NC R/A** (new default) and C + NC All. *C + NC R/A* also moves the copying of graphics data from read ahead to the spare core, which took the work on the game's cores from 12.2 to 1.7 ms per MiB for those reads. *GPU-safe only* is gone; a saved one becomes the default.
- **Settings:** a new *Developer settings* section holds Verify transfers, Enable log and Statistics, and *Reset safe mode* now appears under *Driver*, only when needed.
- **HUD:** one look, the PSVshell style; the classic one and its setting are gone. It now shows read ahead for the game in front and takes less memory.

## Good to know

- Tested on one console: a PCH-1000 on firmware 3.65.
- Read ahead was checked with *Verify transfers* in the tester and in a game, with no mismatches.
- Known issue: opening Settings with VitaShell running once gave error C1-2569-3. The cause is not known yet.

## Install or update

Copy `vitamemio_kernel.skprx` and `vitamemio.suprx` to `ur0:tai/` and restart. Always update the two together. For a new install, add the plugin's lines to `config.txt` first; see the [README](https://github.com/Osaul4ik/vita-memio#install).

To uninstall: switch off every storage in the plugin's settings, remove its lines from `config.txt`, restart, then delete the two files and `ur0:data/vita-memio/`.
